description: Pick up the can from the table and drop it into the trash bin.
success: The can ends up inside the bin (check_success() returns true). Fewer tries, less time, fewer collisions and less energy score higher.
robot_api:
class Robot:
    def get_state(self) -> dict: ...   # {"gripper": [x,y,z], "gripper_open": 0..1,
                                       #  "objects": {"can": [x,y,z], ...},
                                       #  "bin": {"center": [x,y,z], "size": [w,d,h]}}
    def get_image(self, view="front") -> "np.ndarray": ...  # 256x256 RGB
    def move_to(self, xyz, speed=0.2) -> None: ...  # m/s; returns when reached or after 3 s
    def rotate_gripper(self, yaw_deg) -> None: ...
    def open_gripper(self) -> None: ...
    def close_gripper(self, force=1.0) -> None: ...
    def wait(self, seconds) -> None: ...
# The policy runs with only `robot` in scope and is killed after 30 s.
